title: Preferential relocations enhance survival for Markov chains with killing
summary: We investigate the impact on survival of a modification of the evolution of a sub-stochastic Markov chain that involves random relocations at previously visited states. Our central result is that such preferential relocations increase the persistence rate, meaning the survival probability decays more slowly than for the benchmark chain without relocations, and this improvement is strict under mild assumptions.
